content.text:
Nature and science facts about Stegosaurus

Stegosaurus lived about 150 million years ago in the late Jurassic period and was around 9m long. The plates on its back had many blood vessels inside, so it probably used them for temperature control and display. At the tip of its tail were sharp spikes (a "thagomizer"), and fossils have even been found where these spikes pierced the bone of the predator Allosaurus. Its brain was very small compared to its body.

Points worth exploring together

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q. What were the plates on Stegosaurus's back used for?
A. They had many blood vessels inside, so they were likely used for temperature control and display.

Q. Were the tail spikes weapons?
A. Yes. Fossils have even been found where these spikes pierced the bone of the predator Allosaurus.

Q. How can we enjoy it at home?
A. Counting the plates, talking about "the plates warming in the sunlight," and drawing the tail spikes are all great.
